message: The weekend over, Monday back from the break.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah... Life is so boring.」
For some reason, I'd been put on dietary restrictions since last week.
Of course, I knew exactly why.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Sit right there, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? W-What is it?」
That day I spent running away from Muragaki-sensei, Kei-chan came to my room.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I hear you took today off because you weren't feeling well.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-Yeah... My headache, stomachache, and muscle soreness were really bad...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I see. That must have been rough.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uh-huh, it was super rough~」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「And yet, in that condition, you still had the energy to go eat out with an acquaintance？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wha—？！ N-N-No way, of course not！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Setsugekka, I already heard about it from Muragaki-sensei.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'd rather you not tell your own older sister any more pathetic lies.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-Ahahaha...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You told me yourself, didn't you？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That you'd work hard to beat Suzakuin Momiji, so you wanted to do something about losing control」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So I arranged for Muragaki Iori. For your sake.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「H-Haha...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「And yet, you refuse to accept his instruction.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Is this an insult to me？ Or are you trying to provoke me？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eeeek~~ No, no, that's not it~！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Then why the sabotage？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-Um, well, that's...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「There are a thing or two you can't tell even me—that was it, wasn't it?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I don't particularly mind」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「However, don't you think brushing off someone's goodwill without even explaining why is awfully disrespectful？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-Y-Yes, I'm sorry...！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I am angry, Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha, I figured~」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you understand, then mend your ways！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-Yeees！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You have two options: tell me why you won't accept the instruction and ask for my help, or solve the problem through your own efforts」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You may choose whichever one you prefer」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Please don't disappoint me over something so trivial」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hic, sniff... Just remembering it is making me tear up...」
She's normally gentle, but once she gets angry, she corners me so thoroughly I can't squeeze out even a millimeter of an excuse.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sis is way too scary~... She doesn't know how to hold back」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, I'm the one in the wrong, so I guess it can't be helped」
So what did I end up doing? Nothing at all.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, there's no point in telling Kei-chan the reason anyway」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, if I said, 'I'm embarrassed 'cause I got caught masturbating'...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That was your own mistake, wasn't it？ Bear with it and accept the instruction」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...is all she'd say！ And I already know that！」
So I decided not to rely on Kei-chan and just go to class, though.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Ugh~, this is so awkward」
I made it all the way to the front of the Takamura Class classroom, yet I still couldn't bring myself to go inside.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I really shouldn't have mouthed off with 'You'd better watch out next time we meet'~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I have no idea how to face Sensei...」
Pacing around in the hallway.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, I wonder why... I just can't muster up the guts~」
Normally I'd just charge right in on momentum, but I'm not in the mood for that today.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, I get it. This is because of my food！」
Starting the day after Kei-chan got mad at me, carbs vanished from my meals.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Can you believe it? All three meals are nothing but okara, tofu, chicken tenderloin, and stuff like that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't stand a diet like this! I wanna eat white rice~!」
It got way too tough, so I went to the convenience store to buy a rice ball, only to find that my e-money had somehow stopped working.
Thanks to that, I couldn't sneak a single snack.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「*Sniff, sniff* I'm starving... I'm so staaarving...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is totally Kei-chan's doing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan's the only one who'd pull something this wicked and heartless!」
With no other choice, I spent a fruitless day off watching online cooking channels, drooling buckets over all the delicious-looking food.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I can't let things stay like this!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If I don't get my meals back to normal soon, sure, I might lose body fat and get all buff, but my soul is gonna die！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All right! I'll apologize to Sensei, receive some guidance, and get Kei-chan to put my meals back to normal!」
Mustering my courage, creeping slowly into the classroom.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「E-Excuse meee...」
I glanced around restlessly, but nobody was inside.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat, I got all nervous for nothing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Where'd Sensei go? Maybe off doing some sparring practice somewhere?」
Just as I was thinking that, suddenly a delicious aroma tickling my nostrils.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What is this smell...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait—is thaaat...？！」
Lo and behold, sitting on the very back desk was a small serving of fried rice.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Why is there fried rice in a place like this？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Never mind that, though... it looks so good.」
Deprived of carbs these past few days, my body lets out a cry from the depths of my soul.
"Hurry up and consume that"—demanding as much.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I wonder if it's okay to eat this.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...It's fine, right？ Nobody's here anyway！」
Without waiting for an answer, I pick up the bowl of fried rice and scoop the golden grains, glistening with oil, into my mouth with the soup spoon.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nom, nom-nom... S-So goooood！！」
Deliciousness that overturned the standard of all the fried rice I'd ever eaten.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What is this, what is this—it's insanely delicious！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nom, chomp-chomp... Ahh, the carbs and oil are soaking right into my body!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is it~ I knew it, the masses of this country really need rice coated in oil!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh man, fried rice is the beeest！！」
Losing all sense of myself, I frantically shoveled the stir-fried rice into my mouth.
